get.description: Search, filter, sort, group and resolve sessions, within the declared policy

schema.description: Rows per page, clamped by config.pagination.maxLimit
One search term. Matched on: email
JSON: [["field","asc"|"desc"], …]. Sortable: created_at, email, role; when grouped, the group keys and count
JSON: [[field, operator, value], ["or" | "and", …conditions], …]. Filterable: role (string: = != in); email (string: = like starts); created_at (date: > >= < <=)
JSON: [field, …] to return. Allowed: email, role, created_at
JSON: [[relation, { fields, sort, limit, resolve }], …]. Relations: sessions (ip, user_agent, last_seen_at, created_at; at most 10)
JSON: [field, …] to group by; rows become { key, count }. Groupable: role
With group: nest the buckets, one level per key
